narration:2:1620777501:1.text: The party has come to an end. Once all the students have left, you, Pippa, and Professor Solise begin discussing plans for what comes next...
narration:2:1620777501:1.male: The party has come to an end. Once all the students have left, you, Pippa, and Professor Solise begin discussing plans for what comes next...
narration:2:1620777501:1.female: The party has come to an end. Once all the students have left, you, Pippa, and Professor Solise begin discussing plans for what comes next...

say:3:1620777502:1.text: Everyone made a lot of discoveries tonight, but no one's fully figured out chaos magic yet.
say:3:1620777502:1.source_cn: 今天晚上大家果然有了很多发现，不过还没有人得出完整的关...

say:4:1620777503:1.text: Do you think doing this will really make chaos magic less popular? I'm not so sure...
say:4:1620777503:1.source_cn: 我们这样做，真的能让混沌魔法变得不再流行吗？我没什么信心呢。

say:5:1620777504:1.text: Well, everyone worked very hard today. Let's each get some rest, and we'll meet at Verity Plaza tomorrow to see how things turn out.
say:5:1620777504:1.source_cn: 不管怎样，今天大家都辛苦了，我们各自回去休息，明天在真...

narration:6:1620777505:1.text: After spending the night resting in the library, you arrive at Verity Plaza early the following morning.
